content:
We have 13C NMR: signals at 168.20 (likely carbonyl C=O, maybe ester, acid, amide), and aromatic carbons around 127-134. Total 7 carbons observed. That suggests molecule has 7 carbons total. Aromatic ring is 6 carbons, plus carbonyl carbon = 7. So likely a benzoic acid derivative: e.g., benzoic acid (C6H5COOH) has formula C7H6O2. 1H NMR of benzoic acid: aromatic protons 7.5-8.0, 5 H total, yes. However benzoic acid also has a COOH proton (exchangeable) maybe not shown. The 1H NMR only shows aromatic protons, maybe the OH is broad and not reported. So candidate SMILES: O=C(O)c1ccccc1 (benzoic acid). Carbonyl carbon ~ 170 ppm matches. Aromatic carbons around 128-134 matches.

Let's also get IR to confirm carbonyl stretch.
